title: Work calendars
description: Review calendar entries and the employees assigned to each calendar.
unassigned: No calendar has been assigned to you.
oneCalendar: Each employee can use one work calendar.
branchHint: Applies to every employee in the branch.
departmentHint: Applies to every employee in the department.
groupHint: Applies to every employee in the group.
helpIntroJapan: Japanese public holidays are imported automatically from the Cabinet Office when a calendar is created. Refresh holidays synchronizes them again for the displayed year, such as when holidays for a future year are published or corrected.
helpIntroUs: U.S. federal holidays are imported automatically from the Office of Personnel Management (OPM) when a calendar is created. Refresh holidays synchronizes them again for the displayed year. Years not yet published by OPM cannot be imported.
helpRecords: Public holiday records for the displayed calendar year only
helpNames: Holiday names and holiday styling in calendars for that year
helpStats: Annual holidays, working days, and working hours
helpOtherYears: Calendars for other years are not changed.
helpShared: Calendars with the same year and holiday country share public holiday data.
usFederalOnly: The U.S. option includes nationwide federal holidays only. State holidays and the Washington, DC-area Inauguration Day holiday are excluded.
helpCompany: Company-specific days off are added separately as Company holiday entries.
helpOverride: A Working day entry overrides a public holiday for that calendar.
helpFailure: If the refresh fails, the existing holiday data is kept.
